title: AudienceProfile
description: Reader lens profile. Defines tolerance bands, expectation sets, and instantiates named reader personas used by the Reader agent. See core-ontology-v3.md §10 and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 4 T4.3.

genre_expectations.description: List of genre conventions this audience expects satisfied (e.g. 'HEA or HFN', 'satisfying emotional arc', 'chemistry present from chapter 1').

heat_preference.description: Expected heat level. Romance_module heat_level should meet or exceed this for satisfaction.

comp_titles.description: Comp titles (metadata only — no prose retained). Used for market positioning.

tolerance_bands.description: How much of each hard-to-read element this audience tolerates before DNF. Values are 0.0 (zero tolerance) to 1.0 (highly tolerant). Stub — enumerate axes during Phase 4 T4.3.

reader_personas.description: Named reader personas instantiated for evaluation. 3–5 personas covering the target audience spread. Each is passed to the Reader agent.

weight.description: Weight in aggregated reader score (weights across all personas should sum to 1.0).
